data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Modify tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh to add 3 test cases that assert the amended _check_duplicate_pr() guard in merge-to-main-pr.sh accepts draft PRs and refuses non-draft PRs. These tests MUST FAIL RED until T2 (the implementation amendment) is applied.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: merge-to-main-pr.sh while draft PR open → succeeds; while non-draft PR open → refused
- DD4: Unit tests written and passing

## Test Approach

The existing test-merge-to-main-pr.sh already has a gh shim. Extend the `gh pr list` arm of the shim to emit draft vs non-draft JSON payloads controlled by a per-test variable (e.g. `PR_LIST_MODE`):

Case 1 — draft PR present:
Given: `gh pr list` returns `[{"isDraft":true,"number":99,"url":"https://github.com/org/repo/pull/99"}]`
When: _check_duplicate_pr() runs
Then: exit 0 (draft is allowed)

Case 2 — non-draft PR present:
Given: `gh pr list` returns `[{"isDraft":false,"number":99,"url":"https://github.com/org/repo/pull/99"}]`
When: _check_duplicate_pr() runs
Then: exit 1 (non-draft is blocked)

Case 3 — no PR:
Given: `gh pr list` returns `[]` or empty
When: _check_duplicate_pr() runs
Then: exit 0 (no PR, nothing to block)

## Implementation Notes

- Find the existing `gh pr list` arm in the shim (it may return empty currently)
- Add a `PR_LIST_MODE` variable check: when PR_LIST_MODE=draft, emit JSON with isDraft:true; when non-draft, emit isDraft:false; when absent, emit empty
- Each test case sets PR_LIST_MODE before calling _check_duplicate_pr() (source-in the function via a subshell or fixture helper)
- The tests must fail RED because the current code uses `--jq '.[0].url'` which ignores isDraft — it will return a non-empty url for BOTH draft and non-draft cases, making case 2 pass when it should fail

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 3 new test cases added (draft-pass, non-draft-fail, no-pr-pass)
- [ ] gh stub extended to emit isDraft JSON payloads per PR_LIST_MODE variable
- [ ] Tests FAIL RED (exit 1) before T2 is applied — confirm by running the test file against unmodified merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] .test-index: existing entry for merge-to-main-pr.sh already covers this test file (no change needed)
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on modified test file

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: UPDATE: Add behavioral tests for draft-aware _check_duplicate_pr guard
